authorization: The user authorized self-use on public coding tasks, ongoing evidence-backed experiments, and public GitHub/Hugging Face records. This pilot uses existing local ChatGPT Codex login only; no API-key billing, cloud training jobs, new endpoint, or purchased credits.
purpose: Validate the repaired owned executor and independent candidate checks with six fixed requested-profile attempts on three previously authored development tasks. Refresh catalog metadata before choosing profiles; do not equate metadata with backend access. This measurement pilot prepares acquisition of at least2400 distinct final routing requests per claimed domain and cannot replace them.

cli.auth: ChatGPT login locally observed. Copy only required auth.json to a fresh private controlled home outside the model workspace; do not publish or hash credentials. API-key auth and unrelated inherited tokens are refused.
cli.inference_network: Parent CLI may contact its configured official service; model-generated commands have no network permission.
cli.model_identity: Requested model/reasoning and exact applied child invocation are recorded separately from provider-observed identity. Current exec JSONL gives no provider-attested model identity; observed_model remains unknown. Model availability cache is not proof of a successful invocation.

execution.limits: All started CLI attempts count, including provider/auth failures, timeout, capture/parse failure and verifier unknown. One Codex CLI invocation may contain multiple internal model requests and provider retries; those counts are unknown. No executor-level silent repeat to improve a result. Parent-process time is measured separately from verifier time; child CPU/RSS if captured is local CLI, never remote model GPU or backend memory. Fixed CLI invocation count and wall limits bound this pilot; monetary/subscription usage is unknown rather than guessed from tokens.

isolation: macOS only until other enforcement is proven. Use current Codex named permissions profile with root deny, platform minimal read, fresh workspace write, temporary and slash-tmp deny, explicit trusted Go toolchain read, generated-command network disabled, never-approval and no user config/rules/skills/MCP/history inheritance. A real offline probe must demonstrate workspace write, sibling read denial and network denial to a live host-control endpoint before inference. No main checkout edits. Kill/wait child process group before candidate snapshot; retain private traces and numeric record, remove copied authentication after terminal cleanup.

routing_hypothesis.method: Preserve previously measured three Laya abstentions and immutable predictions as historical context. This fixed explicit-profile measurement does not activate routing or reinterpret its configured gpt-6.1-sol standard mapping as a gpt-6-sol prediction. No new Laya inference, fitting or threshold changes.

evidence: Use immutable TaskSpec plus independently pinned base and contract tests. Verify after each terminal candidate snapshot; accepted means only this declared closure. Treat unchanged baseline as rejected and unsupported candidate shape/isolation failure as unknown. Preserve exact stdout/stderr byte hashes privately bound to the owned invocation; publish no raw traces/IDs/credentials/local paths/private source. Task outcome records are public numeric/enum reports for these original Apache-2.0 public fixtures only.
analysis: Report all six planned attempts with launched or prelaunch status. Report closure acceptance independently from process termination and usage completeness; unknown usage must not turn a verified accepted candidate into a failure label. An end-to-end measurement-complete attempt requires process exit0, complete valid core usage and accepted independent closure. Compare reported input/cache/output/optional reasoning and time on paired tasks descriptively only, not money/quota. Cached input and reasoning are subsets, never added twice. Failed/incomplete usage remains unknown while observed partial sums survive. Three distinct tasks in two code families are not six independent tasks, population quality proof, model calibration, or a final 2400-case evaluation. Do not fit/train a router on this pilot or reinterpret expected tiers as measured capability.
stop: Refuse before inference on changed CLI/toolchain/base/spec/auth mode or failed permission probe. Stop remaining scheduled attempts on executor integrity, credential isolation, persistent resource failure or confirmed requested-profile unavailability. Record all started attempts and all unexecuted entries. Individual task rejection alone does not cancel the fixed comparisons. No executor retry, resume, fallback, threshold relaxation or protected-final scoring.
publication: Branch/PR and exact-head CI quality merge gate; race/vet/format/redacted secrets before push. GitHub records code/plans/numeric results and KO/EN guidance. Model binaries, raw traces, authentication and caches stay local; this cycle creates no new model release or production activation. HF may reference the public research record without claiming new weights or validated routing.

supersedes.reason: Plan51 remains stopped after two attempts; its original records and parser reanalysis are immutable. Plan52 uses the corrected parser and separately precommitted refreshed-catalog profile gpt-6-sol, with unchanged public task specs and per-attempt limits. It is not a resumed or silently substituted old comparison.

go_toolchain.evidence: Explicit resolved trusted local installation, version checked offline and executable bytes pinned before inference; no local absolute path published and no hostile-host attestation.

model_discovery.method: codex --no-daemon debug models, fresh authenticated isolated home without prior cache/config, no bundled flag
model_discovery.limit: Read-only refreshed metadata, not entitlement or provider identity attestation. Only a successful completed inference verifies access for that request. Unauthenticated bundled controls also list the two profiles.
